g.text: System Context Diagram - Distributed Food Delivery Platform

text.tspan: Places orders, tracks status, and receives notifications.
Accepts orders, updates prep stages, and manages menus.
Accepts delivery assignments, updates status & GPS coordinates.
Monitors platform health, restaurant revenue, and driver SLA performance.
Choreographs order placement, payment settlement, kitchen prep, and driver dispatch via event streaming.
Browses menus, places orders, makes payments
Inspects analytics, GMV, and SLA metrics
